title.narrative: Support to National HIV/AIDS Response in Jamaica - Jamaica (01-Jan-2025-31-Dec-2027)

description.narrative: Jamaica, HIV, Ministry of Health and Wellness, Jamaica (MOHW)This program has the following goals: To contribute to the control of the HIV epidemic (incidence/prevalence ratio= less or equal to 0.03) in accordance with the goal of the National Strategic Plan, 2023-2030. The objectives of this program are: To improve access by key and vulnerable population to comprehensive HIV testing, prevention and health care services. To increase the number of PLHIV and key and vulnerable populations who are aware of their status, are linked to and retained in care on ART, and achieve and maintain viral. To reduce HIV- related and gender-based disparities among key and vulnerable populations for the realization of human rights. To strengthen the institutional capacity within the health care system to deliver integrated health services and people- centred care to key and vulnerable population
